title: Coolant Overtemperature
description: Coolant temperature P031 = {val} °C, above major threshold (40 °C). Flow rate P030 = {val2} L/min. Thermal control of cutting zone compromised.
probable_cause: Chiller unit failure, high ambient temperature, excessive heat load from cutting, or inadequate coolant tank volume.
diagnostic_steps: Verify coolant tank volume is adequate
Reduce cutting parameters to lower heat generation
remedy: Restore chiller operation. Clean heat exchanger. Allow coolant to cool before resuming heavy cuts.
required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.
escalation_path: If CLS-MJ-001 is not addressed (stop current operation. machine must be inspected before resuming production.), the fault will escalate in this order: CLS-CR-001, then THM-MD-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
